mentions.name: AnomalyArmor
mentions.description: A data observability platform where an AI agent sets up schema-drift, freshness, and row-count monitoring on Snowflake/Databricks in minutes, and users can ask natural-language questions when something breaks. Priced at $5/table, about half what incumbent tools charge.
mentions.problem: Existing data observability tools are priced too high and require hand-configuring per-table thresholds for every new dashboard.
mentions.source_excerpt: AnomalyArmor (http://anomalyarmor.ai) is a data observability platform. I got tired of being priced out of existing tools and hand-configuring per-table thresholds for every new dashboard. An AI agent sets up schema-drift, freshness, and row-count monitoring on Snowflake/Databricks in minutes, and you can ask natural-language questions when something breaks.
